prompt:
Handheld camera along the barrier, tracking sideways fast down the front row and bouncing the whole time. The crowd surges against the barrier, people jump and slam down, arms punch the air on every beat, someone climbs up onto the barrier and is pulled back, beer flies up in a sheet and catches the white light. Faces stay mid-scream and grinning. Sound: crushing crowd roar, shouting with no words picked out, a steel barrier rattling, no music.
Thanks.
